newsitem.title: USA: Capital One plans new Florida facility.
newsitem.headline: Capital One plans new Florida facility.

text.p: Capital One Financial Corp said it acquired a 71.4 acre site near the Tampa International Airport for a new 110,000-square foot customer service facility.
Capital one said it plans to expand its customer service operations in the Tampa area and plans to hire 1,000 new employees. The credit card issuer already employs 450 people in the Tampa area.
Capital One said the site can accommodate up to five buildings and as many as 4,000 employees. According to a news release, the facility will give the company flexibility to support future growth.
Capital One said Hillsborough County, Fla., officials approved the proposal to build on the site and voted unanimously to grant matching funds to the state tax refund program.
Capital One said the facility is being designed by the architecural firm Hellmuth, Obata & Kassabaum Inc. Construction is expected to begin later this month.
Asked what the cost of the project would be to Capital One, a spokeswoman said the company paid "market rates" for the land and said further details were not immediately available.
